{{recipesummary|category=Breakfast recipes
| Yield = 3 ea. 4-section waffles|time=Prep: 10 minutes<br>Cooking: 5 minutes per waffle|difficulty=2
}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Breakfast Recipes|Breakfast Waffle Recipe]]

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 tablespoon [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]s (360 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* ½ cup (120 ml) [[Cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Eggs|eggs]], [[Cookbook:Separate|separated]]
* 1¾ cups (420 ml) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]

==Procedure==

# Lightly [[Cookbook:Brush|brush]] grids of [[Cookbook:Waffle Iron|waffle iron]] with oil, close waffle iron, and preheat according to manufacturer's directions.
# In small bowl, [[Cookbook:Beat|beat]] egg whites until stiff (but not dry) and set aside.
# In large bowl, beat egg yolks until thick and lemon-colored.
# Continue beating, adding milk and oil.
# Add dry ingredients, beat until smooth, and fold in egg whites.
# Pour 1 cup (240 ml) of batter on heated grid, close unit and cook according to manufacturer's directions.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* Spread ¾ cup (180 ml) batter, then quickly cover surface of batter with thinly sliced apples. Close cover and cook as usual.
